deadline: Posting final filing date is 30 September 2026. Electronic cutoff hour and governing timezone are not stated in the retained posting; mailed applications use postmark rule, drop-off hours differ.
reviewGaps: Founder must verify current posting, classification minimum requirements, exam/list eligibility, visa/work authorization, accepted typing certificate and foreign degree equivalency before publication.
